name: Yuey6309 Draft Rewriter with Humanizador de IA
author: humanizadordeia

sections.description:
Humanizador de IA adds a sidebar to the WordPress block editor. Authors can send the current draft to Humanizador de IA, review the rewritten result, and then choose whether to copy it or replace the editor content.

The plugin requires a Humanizador de IA account. Every request is checked against the connected account’s current plan and available credits. Humanization, usage limits, and credit charging are handled by the Humanizador de IA service.

The plugin:

  • Connects one WordPress site through an account authorization screen.
  • Supports the public Humanizador de IA languages and writing styles.
  • Sends a draft only after an editor clicks Humanize draft.
  • Shows the result before any WordPress content is changed.
  • Changes the editor content only after the editor clicks Replace draft.
  • Does not save, update, or publish the WordPress post automatically.

Create or open your Humanizador de IA account at https://besthumanizadordeia.com.

Privacy Policy: https://besthumanizadordeia.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://besthumanizadordeia.com/terms-of-service

External Services

This plugin connects to Humanizador de IA at https://besthumanizadordeia.com.

The service is used to authorize the connected account, read the account plan and available credits, and humanize a WordPress draft after an editor requests it.

Data sent to Humanizador de IA:

  • The current draft title and text.
  • The WordPress site URL.
  • The WordPress post ID and post type.
  • The selected language and writing style.
  • The plugin version.
  • The site connection token created after authorization.

Humanizador de IA returns the humanized text, the public plan name, remaining credits, input limits, and public language and style options. Internal generation details are not returned to the plugin.

Service terms: https://besthumanizadordeia.com/terms-of-service
Service privacy policy: https://besthumanizadordeia.com/privacy-policy

Privacy

Draft text is sent only when an authenticated WordPress editor requests humanization. The plugin does not add visitor tracking, public links, badges, or frontend scripts.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin.
  2. Open Settings > Humanizador de IA.
  3. Click Connect account.
  4. Sign in to Humanizador de IA and authorize the WordPress site.
  5. Open a post or page in the block editor.
  6. Open the Humanizador de IA sidebar and humanize the draft.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Humanizador de IA account?

Yes. Your account controls access, plan limits, and credits.

Does the plugin change my post automatically?

No. It shows a preview first. The editor content changes only when you click Replace draft, and WordPress still controls saving and publishing.

Where is the connection token stored?

WordPress stores the site token in its options table. The settings screen shows only the last six characters.

What happens when I run out of credits?

The request is rejected before generation. Open the plans link in the sidebar to review the available plans.

Does the plugin guarantee that text will bypass AI detectors?

No. Humanizador de IA does not guarantee bypassing AI detectors or a particular detector score. Detector results come from independent third-party systems and may vary between tools, versions, languages, and texts.
